name: Tomato Salad With Curry Lime Yogurt Dressing & Pickled Onions
dish: Platter salad: seasoned heirloom tomatoes with Thai basil laid over a curry-lime yogurt, topped with quick-pickled red onion. Serves 6, eaten right after assembly.

stages.do: toss tomatoes + torn basil with the salt and pepper; rest
ingredients: colorful heirloom tomatoes, halved or quartered if large
fresh Thai basil, torn, plus small leaves for garnish

stages.do: whisk dressing; season to taste; refrigerate
brine: vinegar, sugar, coriander seed, 1 cup water, salt; boil then simmer
pour hot brine on onion slices; cool
ingredients: red onion, thinly sliced into half-moons

stages.do: assemble: yogurt spread on platter, tomatoes on top, onions + small basil leaves last
ingredients: fresh Thai basil, torn, plus small leaves for garnish

splits.ingredient: fresh Thai basil, torn, plus small leaves for garnish

notes: 1 cup water for brine is not in the list. Brine salt amount not stated in source. Source order is tomatoes, dressing, pickle; pickle needs longest (cooling), so a writer may keep source order but must not assemble before onions are cool. Drain onions before topping.
